_comment: Every store image: where it goes (under store/images/), its pixel size, which raw screen it frames (capture.mjs), the frame, the background and the words. compose.mjs reads this file; capture.mjs reads it to know which screens to capture. Backgrounds: indigo (#5566dc to #2c3684, from the app icon), light (#eef1fe to #c3cffb), neutral (#f0f0f2). Frames: mac (26 pt corners and traffic lights), windows (8 px corners, Windows 11 title bar), linux (GTK title bar).
